```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork) #Stitch panels together, make plots look how you want it to 
library(p8105.datasets)

data("weather_df")
```

Scatterplot

```{r}
weather_df |>
  ggplot(aes(x= tmax, y = tmin, color = name)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Temperature (Max vs Min)",
    x = "Max Temperature (C)",
    y = "Min Temperature (C)",
    color = "Location",
    caption = "data from NOAA for three weather stations"
  )
```

Other scales

```{r}
weather_df |>
  ggplot(aes(x= tmax, y = tmin, color = name)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Temperature (Max vs Min)",
    x = "Max Temperature (C)",
    y = "Min Temperature (C)",
    color = "Location",
    caption = "data from NOAA for three weather stations"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(-10, 0, 15), 
    labels = c("-10 C", "0", "Fifteen")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    trans = "sqrt",
    position = "right"
  )
```

Color

```{r}
weather_df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = tmax, y = tmin, color = name)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_hue(h = c(100, 300))
```

Viridis color palette works for any color blindness

```{r}
weather_df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = tmax, y = tmin, color = name)) +
  geom_point() +
  viridis::scale_color_viridis(
    name = "Location", 
    discrete = TRUE
  )
```

## Themes 

```{r}
weather_df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = tmax, y = tmin, color = name)) +
  geom_point() +
  viridis::scale_color_viridis(
    name = "Location", 
    discrete = TRUE
  ) +
  theme_bw() + #white background
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme_classic() + # no grid lines
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") # Order of operation matters 

```

Update tmax vs date plot

```{r}
weather_df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = tmax, color = name)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Season trends in Max Temp",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Max Temperature (C)",
    color = "Location",
    caption = "Max daily temp in three weather stations in 2021 and 2020" 
  ) +
  viridis::scale_color_viridis(
  discrete = TRUE
  ) +
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

Weird but useful plot feature

```{r}
central_park_df = 
  weather_df |>
  filter(name == "CentralPark_NY")

molokai_df = 
  weather_df |>
  filter(name == "Molokai_HI")

ggplot(molokai_df, aes(x = date, y = tmax, color = name)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line(data = central_park_df)


```

Multiple panels with different plot types

```{r}
ggp_tmax_tmin =
  weather_df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax, color = name)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ggp_pcrp_density =
  weather_df |>
  filter(prcp > 0) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = prcp, fill = name)) +
  geom_density(alpha = .5) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ggp_seasonal = 
  weather_df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = tmax, color = name)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

#Patchwork
(ggp_tmax_tmin + ggp_pcrp_density)
(ggp_tmax_tmin + ggp_pcrp_density) / ggp_seasonal
```


## Data manipulation

Start with factors (putting stuff in the order you want)

boxplots

```{r}
weather_df |>
  mutate(name = fct_relevel(name, c("Molokai_HI", "CentralPark_NY", "Waterhole_WA"))) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = name, y = tmax)) +
  geom_boxplot()

```


```{r}
weather_df |>
  mutate(name = fct_reorder(name, tmax)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = name, y = tmax)) +
  geom_boxplot()
```
